order: Add a sizing, cadence and verification protocol built from session telemetry on well-sized, oversized and mega-bundle orders. Optimize effectiveness and wall-clock time, while cost stays structural. In the protocol document, add a new section eight: a sizing gate at planning with split triggers, fan-out chains and refuse-to-emit self-validation for authored tools; cadence for long orders with heartbeats, checkpoint commits as externalized memory and warm resume; and the verification tax — reduce rounds, not depth. Extend the laws with pipelined recon and CHECKPOINT as a scale escalation, and tighten the review phase so finished work is never deferred to batch with future fixes. Give the executor and specialist templates the heartbeat and CHECKPOINT rules and a rule never to under-run the declared verification tier. Add a full or inert tier to the review runner: inert is a claim the reviewer verifies from the diff, unknown values resolve to full, and the launcher passes inert only when the order declares it.
claims: The protocol section, the law and review-phase extensions, the executor and specialist rules, and the tiered runner are all in place, with the tier stamped into the engine header and the optional verification manifest carried into the reviewer's brief. Syntax checks pass on the installer and both hooks, and the runner's usage output shows the new tier option, full or inert. The repository carries no test suite at this point, so the syntax checks and the usage probe are the verification this surface allows.
